d:
Amerika men hue mid tarm chunavon men ripablikan parti ko nirasha hath lag rahi hai. votar sarve men kaha ja raha hai ki tranp ki aarthik nitiyon ke karan ameriki logon men narazgi thi.
Bibisi ke lie siddharth kejrival ne amerika ke teksas men bhartiy mul ke amerikiyon se bat ki aur ye samajhna chaha ki unke kya mudde rahe aur unki kya chintaen hain.
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
(kripya not karen: naya aip briten aur amerika men uplabdh nahin hai.)
